fact: The Bank of South Sudan governor called for faster progress on the Draft National Payment System Bill, 2025, at the close of a five-day validation workshop in Juba on 10-14 August 2026, with the bill not yet passed.

The Bank of South Sudan governor urged swift passage of the Draft National Payment System Bill, drafted in 2025, which would set licensing frameworks as the regulatory foundation for mobile money and electronic banking; reported 17 August 2026.

The Bank of South Sudan opened a five-day workshop on 10 August 2026 to validate the National Payment System Bill, 2025, covering mobile money, e-money, payment switches and RTGS, before its next stage of consideration; the Assembly's Deputy Speaker pledged support.

The Bank of South Sudan began a five-day workshop on Monday 10 August 2026 to review and validate the proposed National Payment System Bill, 2025, ahead of its next stage of consideration; the report is dated 11 August 2026.
